test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

After a hectic day, all he wanted was to rest in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**silence**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**silence**'.
 
• It means 'no noise or sound at all'. (शांति, ख़ामोशी, नीरवता)
 
 
• Example: There must be sile
